messages:
incident-bot: [P1] 503 spike detected in hosted-api-us-west1. rate: 18% 5xx over baseline past 2m. Pager sent to eng-oncall.
Maya Liu: I'm on my way, taking initial triage. Anyone on lunch? :raising_hand:
Kris Patel: I'm online, can take comms until shift swap done.
Maya Liu: Cool. Quick check — is this affecting all model routes or only generation endpoints?
Oliver Zhang: Looks concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat. embeddings unaffected. I see 503s originate from inference-runtime pods returning 502 upstream from model container.
Sophie G: Putting runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/p1-api-503. Follow step 1 (isolate model pool), step 3 (restart unhealthy pods).
Maya Liu: Thanks. Who's taking driver role for mitigation? I'm at end of shift in 8m, need to handoff.
Kris Patel: I can take driver for the next 20m. Sophie, can you be comms until Priya picks up?
Sophie G: On comms. I'll post status and customer impact. Drafting message now.
Priya N: I'm ~5m out of meeting, will be primary after Maya logs off.
incident-bot: Incident runbook state changed: triage_in_progress -> mitigation_in_progress.
Kris Patel: First mitigation: scale down the suspect model pool and failover to canary variant. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment model-pool-legacy --replicas=0
kubectl -n inference scale deployment model-pool-canary --replicas=10
```
Oliver Zhang: Also clearing overloaded workers' KV cache might help: `rdw-runtime admin clear-cache --pool legacy`
Maya Liu: Performing quick log grep to check for OOMs: `kubectl logs -l app=model -n inference | grep -i oom` — none.
Sophie G: Posted to #customers-ops: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors in US-WEST1 for generation endpoints. Some requests may fail with 503. We're routing around affected model pool and will update in 15m."
Kris Patel: After scaling canary up, errors dropped from 18% -> 6% in 60s. Still higher than baseline.
Oliver Zhang: Rolling restart of the proxy layer in us-west1: `k rollout restart deployment/http-proxy -n edge-us-west1`
Priya N: I'm live now and synced. I'll take driver when Maya signs off.
Maya Liu: OK handing off driver -> Priya. Comms stays with Sophie. Kry's still monitoring metrics.
Kris Patel: I'll stay shadowing in case we need rollback.
Sophie G: Updating incident channel with current impact: "Partial degradation; generation endpoints experiencing intermittent 503s; workaround applied (canary failover). Customers on dedicated/private unaffected." :thumbsup: 
Priya N: Taking driver. Action items: keep canary scaled, monitor 5xx rate <2% target, prepare rollback plan if error rate increases on canary.
Oliver Zhang: Prep rollback steps: scale canary down and scale legacy back up, or route traffic to dedicated pool via routing policy.
Maya Liu: Quick note for next shift: suspected config drift in legacy pool proxy timeouts. See /infra/proxy/configs/us-west1/timeout.yaml
Kris Patel: Noted. I'll open an internal ticket with config diff and put it in postmortem queue.
incident-bot: Pager cleared for initial alert. New severity: P1 (mitigating).
Sophie G: Comms update sent to customers-ops and assigned CSMs. Will prepare a short post-incident summary for customers if we hit full mitigation.
Priya N: Thanks everyone. Maya, handing off complete. I'm primary; Sophie comms; Kris backup.
Maya Liu: Thx team, logging off. Good handoff. :wave:
Kris Patel: Night y'all.
Sophie G: I'll keep updates every 5m until closed.
Priya N: Closing note: monitoring shows 5xx at 1.3% for last 5m. Staying on watch for 20m, then we can move to postmortem prep.
incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigation_verified -> monitoring. Incident owner: Priya N, comms: Sophie G.
